about: Labelled retrieval queries over data/Generated_Product_Data.csv (16 products). Written by the author from the product rows before any eval run; relevance is binary and judged by product name. 'relevant' = products that answer the query (within the filters, if any). 'excluded' = products a negation query rules out. Off-topic queries have no relevant product, so the ideal response is empty.
